After a case of murder, which would you like to have more information about, the murderer or the victim? Explain specific reasons for your choice.
Which is more important for you, what you eat or when you eat? Explain your reasons in as much detail as possible.
If you have a time machine, would you go to the past or would you go to the future? What are the major factors affecting your decision?

You are terminally ill with cancer and cannot live for a long time. Would you go through a difficult treatment to prolong your life even for months or get no treatment? Please justify your decision with specific reasons and details.

You have invented a time machine. Would you keep the method a secret and use the machine for your own benefit or release the method for a fee to become rich? Explain the specific reasons behind your decision.
Which do you like better, rice or bread? Don’t fail to give the reasons for your choice.
If you could go on a trip to either Europe or Africa, which would you choose? Explain your reasons with specific details and examples.

Some people enjoy having a quiet dinner with a friend or two, while others prefer eating in a larger group of people. Which type are you? What are the advantages of your choice? Please include specific details in your speech.
Do you perform better when people are watching you? Or, is it better when there is no one around to see you perform? Please do not fail to explain with specific examples and details.
You are sitting on a bus when an old lady and a boy with a broken leg get on. Which one would you give up your seat to? Explain your reasons in some detail.
Which do you dislike more, a person who uses a cell phone on the train or a person who litters the street? Explain your specific reasons.

Some people believe supernatural phenomena exist. Others think it is just an interesting fairly tale for adults. Where do you stand on this issue? You should include specific reasons for your attitude.
You found a young man smoking on the train. Would you say something to admonish him or would you pretend you do not see him? Explain the reason(s) behind your action.
If you become the last man alive on the earth, would you live on or kill yourself right away? Please explain why you chose that action.
Have you ever wanted to be a member of the other sex? When and why? Describe the reason(s) for your desire then. Please be specific.
Some students work hard to make a living while others take out a loan. Which route would you prefer? Support your decision with specific reasons and details.
Some people try to learn what is going on in the world by reading newspapers. Others prefer watching TV news. Which would you prefer? Give specific reasons for your choice.
If you became a teacher, do you think you would prefer teaching boys or girls? What makes you think so? Give specific reasons for your choice.
Would you like to live in your country or in a foreign country after retirement? Why? Give specific reasons for your choice.
People say time is money to mean time is as precious as money. But, which is more precious to you? Give specific reasons for your choice.

In many athletic events in general, and in swimming in particular of late, records are being broken because of the availability of better wears and equipments. Do you think this is a progress, or do you think it is ludicrous? What is your opinion? Give specific reasons.

Some people willingly buy agricultural products from developing countries simply because they are cheaper. However, there has been a concern about their safety due to heavy use of agricultural chemicals. Would you buy them or would you rather not? Explain where you stand on this issue with specific details and examples.
Some people prefer going to the stadium to watch a soccer game, while others prefer watching it on TV. Which would you prefer? Use specific reasons and details to support your choice.

It takes one hour to go to your college from your house. Assuming they cost the same, would you prefer living alone near the campus or living with your family and commute to the campus? Explain your preference with specific reasons and details.

If you are asked by your younger brother whether he should go to the United States to attend a graduate school or go to graduate school at home, which would you recommend? Why do you recommend that option? Explain with specific details.
When you want to read a book, would you prefer buying it or borrowing it from the library? Explain the reasons in some detail.
Some people think the world would be safer without guns, while others disagree. Which opinion do you agree with? Give specific reasons for holding that opinion.
If you could see either a living dinosaur or a Martian, which would you like to see? Give specific reasons for your choice.

You have just won a prize and can choose between a piece of land along a beach and another piece near a lake surrounded by mountains. Which land would you choose? Give specific reasons for your choice.

When you are solving a math problem, are you more likely to give up after some time and look at the answer or spend a long time trying to solve it for yourself? Explain the reasons for your behavior with specific details and examples.
Some people do not mind running a risk, while others prefer taking a safer path. Which type are you? Support your answer with specific details and examples from your experiences.
Which do you like better, you at the age of 10 or you now? Explain the reasons for your answer with specific details and examples
Which do you think are making greater contributions to the wellbeing of humanity, doctors or peace activists? Support your answer with specific details and examples.
When you find a penny on the ground, would you pick it up or would you not? Please explain the reason(s) for your action in some detail.
When you get lost, which do you prefer, asking someone or trying to find the way yourself? Why do you prefer that way? Describe your specific reasons.
Some people move to a foreign country after retirement, while others move back to their hometown. Which would you prefer? Please do not fail to include specific reasons.
Some people think we should abolish death penalty, while other people approve of it. Where do you stand on this issue? Support your answer with specific reasons and details.
Which handicap do you think is easier to live with if it happens to you now, loss of hearing or a loss of the ability to speak? Support your answer with specific details and examples.
Do you get up early or do you sleep until late? Why do you do so? Explain the reasons and the benefits of your style.
When you have a conflict with your boss, are you more likely to concede easily or to try to discuss the issue at length with him/her? Explain the specific reasons behind your attitude.

Sometimes it is better to change the course altogether and start from scratch. Are you more likely to do so or do you tend to persist longer? What are the reasons for and/or the problems with your style? Include specific details.
When one is tired of studying, he/she can either go out to have fun or stay inside and rest? Which do you think is the better of the two? Explain your choice with specific reasons.
When investing money, one can either go for high risk and high return or low risk and low return? Which do you feel makes more sense? Justify your answer with specific details and examples.

There are many young people now who do not join the active work force, preferring to have more free time while working part-time. Do you feel they are simply enjoying their rights to do so or they are doing a disservice to humanity by ignoring their duties? Justify your answer with specific details and examples.
There are those who feel a master’s degree should be a prerequisite to run for public office. Do you agree or disagree with this opinion? Explain your reasons with specific details.
Some feel everyone’s tax rate should be the same. Others think rich people should have higher tax rates. Where do you stand on this issue? How do you justify your opinion?
You have been given a boxed lunch. Do you eat your favorites first or later? Why do you eat that way? Please explain why do you think you act that way?

Do you think there is a positive correlation between one’s academic achievements and his/her ability to succeed as a businessman? Why do you think so? Give specific details and examples to make your points.

You have just won 500 dollars and have been given an opportunity to double it. If you win in the next stage, you will get 1,000 dollars. If you lose, you get nothing. The chance of winning in the next stage is 50%. Would you go for it or would you not? Justify your choice with specific reasons.
When you are sick, are you more likely to ask for help or try to help yourself? Why do you choose that course of action? Explain the reasons with specific details and examples.

Do you want to eat slowly to appreciate the food or finish eating quickly to have time for other activities? Which type are you? Why do you think you are that type? Give specific reasons and examples in your explanation.

Some people are of the opinion that money is the most powerful incentive that drives people, while others think the intrinsic value people see in what they are doing is more motivating? What is your opinion? Don’t fail to include specific details in your explanation.
Do you require absolute quietude to concentrate, or can you tolerate some noise? Explain how you are and why you think you are that way?
When you fall on the street, do you want to be helped by a stranger or would you rather be left alone? Why do you feel that way?
You have an option between being a dictator and being an enormously popular entertainer. Which would you like to be and why? You should include sufficient and specific details in your explanation.

Some parents feel that they have the right and responsibility to make their child choose a career which the parents feel is right. Other parents feel it is best to leave that choice to the child. Where do you stand on this issue?
Humans may be evil by nature. Humans may be noble by nature. Which view do you think is closer to the truth? Explain the reasons for your belief with specific details and examples.
You have a choice between going to the beach and going to a lake up in the mountains. Which would you prefer? Be sure to include specific details in your explanation.
If you were in a position to choose one person for promotion, would you pick someone who is well liked by all or someone who is extremely smart? Support your choice with specific reasons.
Some people play games to enjoy being with others, while other people play to win. Which group do you belong to? Why? Explain in as much detail as possible with specific examples.

Do you think some people are more prone to commit crimes than others for genetic reasons? What is your opinion? How do you feel about this issue? Don’t fail to support your views with specific reasons and examples.
Which do you prefer, being a doctor or being a lawyer? For what reason(s)? Be as specific and as detailed as possible.

Some think it is best if your hobby is your job, while others feel your hobby is no longer enjoyable once it becomes a job. Where do you stand on this issue? Give specific reasons for holding that view.
You have a choice between spending time with your friends and spending time with your parents. Which would you choose to do and for what reason(s)? Justify your choice with specific reasons.

Some may feel they want to live on even after they become vegetables. Others may feel they would rather die if they cannot function like a normal human being at all. Which is your position? Be sure to include specific details and examples.
Running and swimming are two popular forms of exercise. Which do you prefer and for what reason(s)? Please be as detailed as you can.

Trains generally take longer to reach the destination than planes. However, planes generally cost more. Which mode of transportation do you normally prefer? Are there other reasons than the ones mentioned here? Be as specific as possible.

Some feel today’s youngsters are spoiled as human life has become too convenient. Others think it is great that they now can live much more comfortably since it allows them to spend their energy on more meaningful activities than securing a comfortable living. What is your view? Justify it with details and specific examples.

Which do you think is more valuable, an easily earned victory or a loss despite your best effort? Please support your opinion with details and specific examples. You can either talk about a special case or provide a more general argument.
Health and wealth, which is more important to you? Support your views with specific examples.

Suppose a dog is trapped at the bottom of a deep hole and it costs the rescuers 10,000 dollars to save its life. Do you feel it should be saved or it is too big an expense for a dog? Support your decision with a detailed argument.

Some feel owning a gun should be prohibited for the general public, while others feel we should all be allowed to possess firearms for self-protection. Where do you stand on this issue? Justify your position with specific details.

Some are of the opinion that endangered species should be protected at all costs. Others think the expense involved does not justify taking such protective measures. Which side are you on? What are your reasons for supporting that side? Please be as specific as possible in your argument.
Which do you prefer, playing a musical instrument or playing tennis? Explain why it appeals to you more. Make sure to give specific reasons for your choice.
Which makes you feel more proud, getting a good score on a test yourself or helping someone get a high score on a test? Explain the reasons in sufficient detail.
Would you be more motivated to work harder when you are the best or when you are the second best? Explain how you feel with specific reasons and details.

There are those who think the idea of a second chance spoils people. Then, there are those who believe everyone is entitled to a second chance. Where do you stand on this issue? Don’t fail to give specific reasons and details.
Some prefer calling to apologize for mistakes, whereas others think it is better to write a letter of apology. Which is your choice and why?

Some people believe that reading the textbook before the class is essential to get the most out of the lecture, while others believe it is more effective to read the book after the lecture. What do you normally do? Why do you think it works better for you?
Which do you think is a worse crime, killing someone accidentally or injuring someone intentionally? Justify your view with specific reasons and examples.
You have a chance to visit either your alma mater or a school you have never been to. Which would you pick? Why is it your choice?
Some think the ultimate goal of science is to make mankind happy. Others feel the goal should be a genuine pursuit of knowledge and truth. Which do you think is the goal of science?
On your birthday, do you want people to have a party for you or just leave you alone? Give a detailed explanation of your preference.

When you learn a friend of yours has just made a big mistake at school or at work, would you call him/her right away to see how he/she is doing or do you wait until he/she contacts you? Justify your action with specific reasons and explanations.

Do you think it is crazy to try to be perfect because no one is perfect, or do you think it is crazy not to try to be perfect since no one can be perfect despite the best effort? Explain your position with sufficient and detailed reasons.

Some prefer acting quickly when there is a problem since they believe it is best to try to fix it right away. Others take time and analyze the situation before they finally make a move. Which do you think is a better course of action? You should include your reasons for choosing that option. Please be as specific as possible.
Compare a situation in which you have to choose between money and fame. Provided you can get either but not both, what would you do? How do you justify that choice?

Some people feel those who say they do not live for money are simply dishonest, while others think dishonest people live for money. Which side do you think is right? Why do you think so? Your answer should be both detailed and specific.

You are going to a shop in the same town. It will take 30 minutes to get there if you walk. But, you can also take a bus to get there. It will be a 10-minutes’ ride. Provided you have sufficient time, would you walk or would you take a bus. Supply the specific reasons for your decision.

You have a 50% chance of winning $10 if you bet on team A. Your can win $20 if you bet on team B. However, the chance of winning is only 25% for team B. Needless to say, the expectation values are the same at $5 for these two options. Which team would you bet on? Explain why you picked that team with specific reasons.
“Criminals may have good reasons to commit crimes.” Do you think this statement makes sense, or do you not? Describe the reason(s) behind your view. Be as specific as possible.

Do you believe in doing a good thing even if you are the only one to do it, or would you rather wait until someone starts doing it? Why do you act like that? Your reason(s) should be as specific and detailed as possible.
Would you send your child to a private school or a public school? What are the justifications for your choice?

Suppose you are very rich. Are you more likely to think the higher tax rate for you is fair or think paying a larger amount is unfair as it was a result of your effort? Explain which case you think is more likely to happen. Your reasons have to be specific.
Do you or do you not support death penalty? What makes you feel that way? Provide sufficient detail in your explanation.

In the middle of the game, it became clear that your chance of winning was slim. Would you still try your best to win or try to take it easy to save strength for your next game? What are your specific reasons for making that decision?

Are you more comfortable if you are surrounded by your friends when you take an examination, or do you prefer being alone? Why do you have that preference? Explain in as much detail as possible with specific reasons.

Some people don’t pay much attention to grammatical mistakes in their English as long as they can communicate well. Others are not satisfied unless their English is grammatically correct. Which position do you take and for what specific reason(s)?

Are you able to memorize seemingly insignificant facts if that is required to pass a test, or do you have much difficulty unless you feel they are significant? Try to explain your mentality to someone who does not know you at all.
“It is the hallmark of adulthood that one can do what he/she does not like if it needs to be done.” On what specific ground(s) do you or do you not agree with this statement?
When a project is not going well, are you more likely to try something else or try to improve the current operation? What makes you act like that? Give a sufficiently detailed account.
If you cannot get into the college of your choice, would you consider it a defeat or would you be satisfied as it was the best you could do? Specific and detailed reasons are requested.

Frustrating results could help one to achieve more. Frustration could badly affect the desire to work hard. Which do you think is more likely to happen to people? Why is it? Be as specific and detailed as possible in 45 seconds.
Are you planning to go to graduate school or are you not? Whether it is just how you feel or it is a well-informed decision, explain the reasons for your decision.
In your opinion, is a good health more important than the pleasure of drinking? Specifically, what makes you hold that opinion?

In order to defend your honor, would you willingly relinquish a material gain, or is it the other way around? Explain which course of action you are more likely to take. It is important that your explanation contains specific examples and details.
You have a choice between going out to drink and taking a long bath at home to recover from a bad mistake you have just made. Which would you pick and for what reason? Be as specific as possible.
Which do you envy more, someone with an expensive painting and someone with an expensive car? Assume that their dollar values are the same. Your explanation must include specific reasons.
If your brother were smart enough to become either a doctor or a theoretical physicist, which career do you think he should follow? Your reasons should be specific and detailed.

Your parents want you to succeed to the family business which is very lucrative. Your boyfriend/girlfriend wants you to go abroad with her to study. If there is no way to compromise these options, which would you choose to do and for what reason(s)? Specific reasons are particularly important.

You have just passed an examination which your best friend has failed. Would you wish to run into him/her today or would you rather not meet that person? What makes you feel that way? Give specific reasons for feeling that way.

You can donate money to your alma mater to improve their education. But, you can also donate that money to an organization that feeds the hungry. Which would you give your money to if you are forced to choose only one of them? Justify your choice with specific details.

“Saving children’s lives is more important than saving the lives of senior citizens.” Do you agree or disagree to this statement? Could you come up with good and specific reasons to support one of these positions?

You have just won $10,000 in a lottery. If you have to either put the entire amount in the bank and keep it there until after retirement or spend the whole $10,000 to purchase a piece of land, what would you do and why? Your reasons have to be both specific and detailed.

In order to prepare for a natural disaster, would you give priority to regular drills to learn the escape routes or stocking enough food and supplies? How do you justify your priority? Be as specific and detailed as possible.
Which do you like better, eating out or cooking at home? Give specific reasons for your preference.
Some believe in the power of persistence, while others think giving up is a highly viable option. Which opinion do you subscribe to and for what specific reasons?
Would you go to a developing country yourself and help the people there or just donate money to send people there? Give your specific reasons for the action.
Which do you think is more difficult to cope with for you, lack of sleep or lack of food? Give specific details in your explanation.

There are people who think the government should not interfere too much with its citizens’ lives. But, there are others who believe the problems of modern society are out of control due to too little regulations by the government. Where do you stand on this issue? What specific reasons and details can you give to support your opinion?
If you were to volunteer your time, would you like to help the children or the elderly? Why do you have that preference? Be as specific and detailed as possible.

In the morning of an important test, do you go through your daily routine as usual or do you do something different such as getting up earlier, eating better food, and drinking an extra cup of coffee? What specific justifications do you have for your action?

Due to the recent economic downturn, stock prices have gone down considerably. There are those who say now is the time to buy, while others are afraid it could go down much further. What is your position on this? Give reasons for taking that position. You do not have to offer an expert opinion. Just explain how you feel about it.

Old people may be more reluctant to try new things. Do you think this is because they are already comfortable with what they have or do you think it is because they are more afraid of failures? Be sure to include specific reasons for your view on this.

Some countries have free medical care in exchange for a heavy tax. In other countries, medical costs are very high, but their tax rates are not. Which do you prefer? Why? Your reasons should be specific and detailed enough.
You have been asked to serve on a jury, would you do so willingly or reluctantly? Explain the specific reasons for feeling that way.

You are on a long flight, say 10 hours. Are you more likely to talk with the stranger sitting next to you or to remain silent? Why do you take that action? In your account, please be as specific and detailed as possible.

The idea of the distribution requirement at colleges in the United States is to expose the students to diverse disciplines. However, in England, college students only take classes in their fields of specialization. Which philosophy do you subscribe to and for what specific reason(s)?

Your child has failed to pass the entrance examination for the college of his/her choice. Would you encourage him/her to spend an extra year to study for the next year’s entrance examination or do you want him/her to attend the college that admitted him/her this year?
Your business is going bankrupt. Are you more likely to think that it was your fault since you were at the helm or think it was nobody’s fault as it was sheer bad luck?
Do you think novels are stranger than facts or facts are stranger than novels? Give specific reasons for your opinion.
You are going to a distant location by car. Do you feel more nervous about traffic accidents when you are driving or when someone else is driving?

You have to return a loan today. If you do not have enough money to do so, would you borrow money from someone else to return the loan or ask for an extension? Which action makes more sense to you? Be as specific and detailed as possible.

Your parents want you to study medicine in college, but you want to study physics. If choosing physics means to pay for your college education yourself, which career would you pursue? Please support your choice with specific reasons and details.

Some feel it is acceptable to skip classes from time to time. Others feel attending classes should be given absolute priority. What is your opinion? Please support your views with specific reasons and details.

If you are given a choice between reading a how-to book and attending a workshop to learn how to grow vegetables, which is your preferred course of action? Why do you think it will work better for you? Mention specific reasons for your choice.
When you go on a business trip, do you prefer going alone or going with someone else? Please support your preference with specific reasons and details.

You have to study for an examination. Would you stay at school and study or go home to study? Why does that choice work better for you? Explain the reasons for making that choice with specific details.

Do you think the elderly should always take the seat offered to them on a train by a younger person so as not to embarrass him/her? Where do you stand on this issue? Please support your views with specific reasons and details.
Which would you rather play, a team sport or an individual sport? Describe the reasons for your preference in specific terms.

You have to travel to a region, where security is a concern, to make good profits. Are you more likely to go or stay home and settle for a much smaller profit. Explain the reasons behind your action. Be as specific and detailed as possible.
Do you feel males are stronger than females or females are stronger than males mentally? What makes you feel that way? Give specific examples to explain your view.

Some feel it is fair to share everything equally among all people. Others believe you should be allowed to keep what you gained yourself? Which is closer to your opinion? Justify your position with specific reasons and examples.

Some teachers believe originality is the most important quality, while others believe mimicking is a good way to learn. Who do you think is right? Use specific reasons and details to support your opinion.
There is a math problem you cannot solve. Are you more likely to ask someone or try to find some clues in books? Why do you choose to do so? Make your explanation as specific as possible.
You have a choice between mailing your application documents and applying online. Which are you more likely to do and why? Please support your action with specific reasons and details.
Which appeal to you more, novels or poems? Explain why it is your preference with specific reasons.

There are two types of community leaders, those who are not afraid to fight and those who try to avoid fighting at all costs. Which attitude do you support? Why? Be as specific and detailed as you can.
What is your view of modern science? Is it evil or is it a blessing? Provide specific reasons and details for your opinion.

There are those who believe development is more important than preserving historic structures. On the other hand, there are also those who believe development that does not respect such structures is meaningless. Which type are you and for what specific reasons? Be as detailed as possible.
Some claim that fishing is a nature-loving activity. Others claim it is destroying nature. Which side do you stand by for what reasons? It is important to be as specific and detailed as possible.
In which are you healthier, a cold weather or a hot weather? Explain why you think you are that way with specific details.

Which do you think is more difficult, leaving home or seeing off someone who is leaving home? Base your argument on your experience if you have such. Else, just guess which one you think is harder. Either way, provide specific reasons for your view.
In your opinion, which is sweeter, a coming-from-behind win or a very easy victory? Give specific reasons for your choice.

Some people buy an expensive car to show off. Others do so because of the smoother and more comfortable ride. Quite honestly, which type do you think you are? What do you think made you that way? Specific reasons and details are requested.

You have already been waiting for a train for a long time when someone started to complain about the delay to the station staff. “Desperation is the best way to become productive.” Do you agree or disagree with this statement? Please support your views with specific reasons and details.

You have just finished a big project successfully and have a choice between going for a bigger project right away and taking a vacation. Which do you think you are more likely to do? Give specific and detailed reasons for your choice.

You have enough fund to buy an expensive computer. Would you buy a machine with a much higher specification than you currently need since you may need such a machine later, or would you settle for what you need now and save money? Justify your choice with specific reasons and details.

Some find it easier to follow the trend. Others feel it is disgusting to be the same as others. Do you normally follow the trend or do you not? Explain why you are that way with specific reasons.

Are you willing to participate in a contest where your appearance is the only thing that is judged? Give reasons why or why not. Make sure your reasons are both specific and sufficiently detailed.

“Wealth destroys one’s work ethic.” Do you agree or disagree with this statement? Include sufficient details in your explanation.
Eating everything on the plate is praised by some and frowned upon by others. Do you normally eat everything on the plate, or do you not? Explain why you do so with specific examples and details.

Your father has gone through an operation, and the doctors removed a small cancer. It is likely that he is now completely cured. Would tell your father about the cancer or would you not? How do you justify your choice? Be as specific as possible.

Some people find it acceptable for the parents to send gifts to their children’s teachers. Others feel it is best avoided. Where do you stand on this issue? Please support your views with specific reasons and details.

Are you more likely to make decisions for subjective reasons or applying objective criteria? What are the advantages of your style of decision making? Please justify your action with specific reasons and details.

Your neighbor put out their garbage for pick-up on a wrong day, and it is not clear whether it was a sheer mistake. Would you talk to them right away or wait and see what they will do next time? Please support your action with specific reasons and details.

Are moving TV shows more moving if you watch them with your friends? What is your experience? Explain why you think they are more (or less) moving when you watch it with your friends. Be as detailed as possible.

Do you want to be paid by the hour or based on the job you can finish? Why is it your choice? Please include specific reasons and details in your explanation.
“Too much comfort is not good for your discipline.” Do you agree or disagree with this statement? Why do you hold that opinion? Please support your views with specific reasons and details.

Some say teaching is the primary responsibility of college professors, while others think research is more important. What is your view? Please support your opinion with specific reasons and details.
If your father teaches at the same university, do you or do you not try to avoid his classes? Your reasons should be as specific as possible.

Many people seem to believe justice is what the majority does. However, just as many seem to think justice is justice even if you are in the minority. Which position is yours? Please support your views with specific reasons and details.

You work for the government and are responsible for deciding how to spend a large sum of money for research. Would you put more emphasis on humanities or sciences? What do you base your decision on? Please support it with specific reasons and details.
Which do you think is more powerful, the pen or the sword? Your opinion should be adequately supported by specific details and examples.
You can work as a volunteer either to save the environment or to feed the hungry. Which would you pick for what specific reason(s)?

You are running for an office. If you make big campaign promises, you are likely to win. If you only promise to do what you know you can do for sure, you could lose the election. Which strategy would you choose? Please support your choice with specific reasons and details.

Some people make donations for publicity. Others prefer remaining anonymous. If you were to make a huge donation, would you go for publicity or stay anonymous? Why? Explain in concrete terms with sufficient details.
“There are good lies and bad lies.” Do you agree or disagree with this statement? It helps if you can give concrete examples in your answer.

Imagine a typical boxed lunch. Some eat their favorite items first, while others save them till the end. Which type are you? Why? What is your self-analysis? Please include as much detail as you could.

Your university is closing its doors and you are given a choice between transferring to an equally prestigious institution and remaining at your current institution to become the very last graduate. Which of these two choices would be yours? Why is it your choice? Please support your decision with specific reasons and details.
If a teacher spends more time with weaker students, is it fair or unfair? Support your position with specific and detailed arguments.

Almost all youngsters start drinking as soon as they enter college even though they are still under 20 (Note: This is the minimum drinking age in Japan.). Suppose everyone around you is drinking in the freshman year, would you join them and consume alcohol or would you not? What is the basis of your decision? Please support your choice with specific reasons and details.

Some students feel that it is their duty to report cheating during an exam. Others don’t feel comfortable with turning in their classmates. How do you feel about this? Discuss what you would do with detailed and specific reasons.
“School uniforms enhance solidarity among the students.” Do you agree or disagree with this claim? Your answer should include sufficient details.

Would you get up early every morning and run a few miles to live longer than average or do nothing and have the average longevity? Which appeals to you more? Explain why you prefer that life style with specific details.

You are given a chance to debut as a singer out of the blue. Would you grab the chance or would you rather stay on course with the current career? Why is it? Explain the reasons with specific details.

Those who are against the concept of a zoo say a caged tiger is not a real tiger and hence is not worth watching. Those who like the idea of a zoo are enthusiastic about being bale to see the wild animals without traveling to their natural habitat. Which view makes more sense to you? A specific and detailed argument is requested.
A small car is friendly to the environment. A big car is safer when involved in a traffic accident. Which is your choice? Why? Explain in sufficient detail why you arrived at that decision.
When they say there is a 50% chance of rain, would you take your umbrella with you or would you not? Explain why with specific reasons and details.
Do you agree or disagree that politicians cannot remain completely honest as the people they deal with are not honest? Describe your views in detail with specific examples.
Do you normally arrive for a meeting with plenty of time to spare or just in time? Why are you like that? Give specific details about how you are and how it happens.

Some people work much harder when their boss is watching them. Others can work hard without a close supervision. Which type are you? Why are you of that type? Give specific and detailed reasons in your speech.
Do you tend to over-prepare or under-prepare for your presentation? How does it happen? Describe your preparation with specific examples and sufficient details.

Some believe diligence is an inborn characteristic largely determined by the genes. Others believe diligence is an acquired trait. What is your opinion? Why do you believe so? Explain with examples and details. Be as specific as possible.
People are calling you an odd person. Is it derogatory or is it a compliment for you? Explain why you feel that way in sufficient detail. Specific examples will help.

You are given two optional locations for your vacation, one is your hometown and the other is a place you have never been to? Which would you choose and why? To make your explanation clear and convincing, you should include some concrete examples.
Which do you admire more, a very versatile person or someone who is second to none in one specific area? Don’t fail to include specific reasons and examples.

Which do you think would work better if you want to get in the habit of getting up early enough in the morning, having someone come to your house every morning or implementing a stiff fine for being late? Answer this question in sufficient detail, making sure concrete reasons are included.

Which situation do you find more embarrassing, to fall asleep during the class and get scolded by the professor or to slip and fall on a frozen surface? Be sure to mention concrete reasons in your speech.
In your opinion, which is more impressive, human creation or natural formation? Explain how you feel by giving specific examples of both and comparing them.

Which is true courage, to report your good friend’s wrong doing to the police or to provide a shelter for him/her knowing you will become an accomplice? Explain your value system in your answer. Concrete examples will help delineate how you feel.

As you are approaching a pedestrian crossing, the green light begins to flash. Would you run across or wait until the next green light? What do you normally do and what does it tell you about yourself? Please include specific reasons and details in your statement.

When you get your salary, do you put some in the bank before you start spending or put what is leftover at the end of the pay period in the bank? What is your saving habit is like? What do you think it tells you about yourself? Specific reasons and details are requested.
Some people work just to earn money. Others work since they enjoy making contributions to society. What is your primary reason for working? Explain how you feel in sufficient detail.

Some children think the best way to make their parents happy is to lead a happy life themselves. Others feel they should show to their parents how much they love them by saying so and sometimes by giving gifts. Which view is yours? Be as specific and as detailed as possible.

Some workers are good at doing routines perfectly giving stability to their organizations, while others are good at coming up with new ideas helping the organization grow. Which type are you? Please be as concrete and detailed as you can in your explanation.
Some people cannot sleep when their stomachs are full. Others cannot sleep with an empty stomach. Which type are you? Describe concrete situations where you have difficulty falling asleep.
“Thinking about and marvel at our dreams help us keep going however unachievable they may seem.” Do you agree or disagree with this statement? Please include examples and some details in your answer.

One of your classmates cleans the blackboard before the professor arrives. Sometimes, the professor shows up while he is still erasing what is on the board and thanks him for the kind assistance. You do not know exactly why he does it. Are you more likely to think he is an apple polisher or he is a very kind and helpful student? Support your argument with specific reasons.

You have just moved to a new school. No one seems to be willing to talk to you or sit with you at lunch time. Would you wait until someone finally decides to talk to you or would you try to initiate a conversation with someone who seems accessible? What would you do in that kind of a situation? Explain what you might do as well as how you might feel when this happens to you in concrete terms and in some detail.

“The best time in life is when you are young and lacking experience. As you age, reality weighs in too heavily for you to try anything new and wild.” Do you agree or disagree with this claim? Please support your argument with specific reasons and details.

Some say we get wiser with age. Others believe old people simply have found what work well and keep doing them. Where do you think the truth lies? Explain the reasons for your position in sufficient detail.

Do you think you can work harder when you like what you are doing, or do you believe you are more diligent when you are convinced your job is meaningful for society? Describe how you feel and why with specific reasons and examples.

You can decide beforehand whether you would like to donate your organs after death. Would you do so or would you not? What are your reasons? It is important that others can clearly understand your reasons.
You can either set up a commemoration day or build a monument to celebrate the achievements of a Nobel laureate. Which is your choice? Support your choice with concrete arguments. Examples may help.

Your parents want you to become a doctor and are willing to support you financially until you graduate. But, you want to become an actor even though they will not provide any financial support in that case. If you were in this situation, which career are you more likely to pursue? What are your reasons for that choice? Be as specific as possible with sufficient details.

“In order to experience a foreign country, it is not enough to attend a school there. One can see what that country is all about only if he/she works there.” Do you think this statement is true or do you not? Explain why you think so with specific reasons and examples.

You can either subscribe to a newspaper and have it delivered to your home every day or buy one at the newsstand when you need it. Which would you prefer and why? Support your choice with specific reasons.
If you were to appear on a TV news, would you like to be identified or remain anonymous? Explain your reasons specifically in as much detail as you can in 45 seconds.

Some believe one’s effort is as respectable as a good result. Others feel the result should weigh more heavily. How do you feel about these opinions? Which side are you on? Why? Support your views with specific examples.
If you were starving to death, would you steal food or beg for food? What would you do? Justify your action with a detailed reasoning.
Some people prefer a quiet life while others enjoy much public attention. Which would you prefer and for what reason(s)? Give specific reasons for your preference.

In your opinion, should people be allowed to possess a gun to protect themselves? Some feel it is an intrinsic right of the citizens to protect themselves. But, some feel it is one of the reasons for the high crime rate? Where do you stand on this? Share your views with specific details and examples.

Your child is having much difficulty with the schoolwork. Are you more likely to help the child or tell the child to try for himself/herself? On what grounds would you take that attitude? Be as specific and detailed as possible.

Do you think countries have the right to intervene if they see human rights violations happening in other countries? Or, do you think sovereignty should be respected at all costs? What is your position? Give specific arguments to support your position.
If you were to lead another life either as a cat or a dog, which would you choose and for what reason(s)? Explain your choice with specific reasons.
Who do you think are happier, those who are poor but with much free time and those who are rich but with little free time? Describe the reasons for your choice

You have a choice between a flawlessly stylish room which is a little inconvenient and a functionally perfect room which looks somewhat bleak. Which would you like to live in? Support your choice with specific details and examples.

Some believe it is ineffective to try to protect the global environment individually, while others believe such grass-roots efforts are very effective. Which opinion do you support and why? Your explanation should be with specific examples and detailed.

In some countries, children get extra money in addition to their regular allowances from the parents and relatives at the beginning of the year. Do you think it is a good custom or do you not? Your explanation should include specific examples and/or details.

Some believe innocent children have therapeutic effects while others feel they are too demanding of extra care. Do you agree or disagree with the following statement? “Playing with young children is good for your mental health.” Support your argument with specific details and personal examples.

As a woman, or if you were a woman, which type would you prefer, a typical and traditional housewife or a career-oriented single woman devoted to her job? Please explain why you prefer that type with specific reasons. Some examples may help.

If your child shows an interest in your father’s, i.e. his/her grandfather’s, job, would you encourage him/her to pursue that career? Do you or do you not support that choice and for what reason(s)? Include specific reasons and details in your explanation.

You have enough funds to start your own business or invest in someone else’s business. Which would you choose? Why is it your preference? Describe the reasons behind your choice with sufficient details.

Do you agree or disagree with this statement? “People are influenced much more by their emotion than reason in their daily decision making.” Please include specific reasons, examples, and details in your explanation.

When there is a problem, are you more likely to point it out right away in so many words or to try to bring people’s attention to it in a more roundabout manner? Why do you have that style? Try to convince people that your style is better than the other option with specific examples and details.
Do you believe humans are really created equal? Give specific reasons and details to support your view.
Which would you prefer playing, or do you think you would prefer playing if you tried both, soccer or baseball? Your speech should include specific and personal reasons for the preference.

Some believe one should be regarded as an adult once he/she reaches the age of 18. Others believe eighteen-year-old people are still socially immature to be treated as adults. What is your opinion? Support it with specific examples.
Do you agree or disagree with the opinion that women should quit the job after childbirth and concentrate on housework and raising children? Include specific details in your argument.

Some work for hours in a row and take a long break. Others do better with shorter and more frequent breaks. Which mode do you prefer? Why do you think that works better for you? Please explain your preference with specific details and/or examples.

Suppose you have two things to finish on the same day. You like one of them and do not like the other. Which would you typically do first? For what reason? Explain your behavior with specific and detailed reasons.

If you have a choice between taking the elevator and walking up the stairs to the third floor, which would you choose and for what reason(s)? Support your decision with specific reasons and sufficient details.

Recent advances of information technology have enabled us to use the Internet to get a wide variety of information easily. However, getting information from books is also important for us. Which mode of gathering information do you like better, on the net or from books? Support your answer with specific details and examples.

Compare the advantages and disadvantages of having a part-time job and explain whether you think it is a good idea or bad idea to work part-time for college students. Be sure to include specific details to support your opinion.

In order to be well prepared for a disaster, some people stock food and others buy a first aid kit. In your opinion, which will be more crucial to have if a disaster indeed struck? Support your opinion with specific reasons. Examples may strengthen your point.

Your dog is drowning in a river in the middle of winter. While it is only a few yards away from the shore, you have no idea how deep the river is there? Would you try to save the dog yourself or would you run for help? Justify your action with a specific and detailed explanation.

Very objectively speaking, do you think your father is more important than other people’s fathers? State your position on this issue and explain why it is an objective viewpoint. Be sure to include specific details to support your opinion.

You are a soldier and running away from the enemy in the middle of a jungle. You are with some other soldiers from the same troops. One said it is better to stay together to defend yourselves. Another said it would be easier for the enemy to spot you if you stayed together and suggested you flee individually. Which one would you agree with and for what specific reasons? Justify your choice with sufficient details.
Which should one eat more for, lunch or dinner? Why?
Some people prefer to live in an apartment. Others prefer to live in a house with a yard. Which place would you prefer to live in? Explain with specific reasons.

Some students go directly to the teacher when they can not solve a problem on the homework assignment. Others ask their friends first. Which do you prefer? Your answer should include specific details and examples.

Some believe one’s IQ is a good indicator of his/her innate smartness, while others believe the IQ is nothing but an artifact without much significance. Which opinion would you support and for what reason(s)? Be as specific and detailed as you can in your explanation.
You have a choice between writing an essay and writing a poem. Which would you choose? Explain your choice with specific reasons.
You can invite either a famous singer or a famous scientist to your birthday party. Which would you prefer? Support your choice with sufficient details.

Some people try to save money as we do not know what will happen in the future. Others spend as much as they earn to have fun since we do not know what happens next. Which attitude do you think makes more sense? Support your opinion with as much specific detail as possible.

There are people who enjoy helping others. But, there are also others who prefer not to interfere with other people’s business. Which type are you and for what reason(s)? Please include specific details and reasons in your speech.
If it takes the same time to get to the destination, would you prefer traveling by car or by train? Explain your reasons with specific details.
Suppose you are on crutches. Would you want others to treat you as usual or try to provide extra help? Why? Please include specific details and reasons in your speech.

Some parents believe in strict discipline for their children. Other parents think children should be loved and spoiled to some extent. Where do you stand on this issue? Support your view with specific reasons.
You have a choice between seeing a movie on TV and seeing the same movie at a movie theater. Which would you prefer?
You can either buy a cheap pair of shoes or a more expensive pair that would last longer. Which are you more likely to buy and why? Support your decision with specific and detailed reasons.
Some people fear insects. Others do not. Which type are you and for what reasons? Explain your attitude towards them with detailed reasons.

Some experts say college students need to have time to spend alone and advise them to have their own rooms. Other experts believe it is better to have a roommate/roommates to learn how to socialize. Which side are you with? Be specific in your explanation.
If you compare young workers with older workers, do you believe older ones are more responsible? Explain why you feel or do not feel this way with specific reasons.

Some people work or study better under time pressure, while others are more effective when they have plenty of time. Which type are you and why? Include specific reasons in sufficient detail in your explanation.

Suppose you do not need a college degree to get a job that pays just as much. In addition, you can start working early if you do not go to college. If you were in that situation, would you still go to college or would you not? Justify your choice with specific reasons.

Extracurricular activities can help you gain new skills or enjoy doing something different. They can also help you gain a network of friends. Which would be your primary reason for engaging in such activities? Be as specific and detailed as possible.
Some executives have a secretary to help them. Others prefer to do everything themselves. Which would you prefer if you were a corporate executive? Support your preference with specific reasons.
Some people go out at night to have fun. Others stay home and relax. Which would you prefer? Explain your preference in some detail. Your speech should include specific reasons.

Some people feel financial security is a necessary ingredient for a good marriage. But, others think love is the only necessary condition for a good marriage. Where do you stand on this issue? Explain your view with specific reasons.
Some people welcome other people’s curiosity about you and your life. Others prefer being left alone. Which do you prefer and why? Your speech should include specific and reasonably detailed reasons.

There are people who do not put their job titles on the name cards they give to friends. There are also those who feel the job title is an important part of one’s personal information which should not be left out. Which practice is yours and why? Be as specific as possible when you give your reasons.

Suppose you have an assignment due in a week. Are you more likely to finish it little by little on a daily basis or get it all done over a couple of days? Support your preference with specific reasons.
Some people enjoy meeting new people. Some people feel nervous when they have to meet new people. Which type are you more like? Explain your inter-personal characteristics with specific details.

Some parents believe preschoolers do not need to get any cash, while others believe it is good to give them some allowances to teach how to spend money wisely. Which opinion do you hold? Give specific and detailed reasons to support your point.
Some people marry in their twenties. Others prefer to wait until they are much older to start a family. Which is your preference? Explain your specific reasons with sufficient detail.
Which would you like to do less tonight, going to see a movie or listening to classical music? Explain why you do not like that option with specific reasons.
Which makes you more uncomfortable, someone praising you in front of others or being in a large crowd of strangers? How is it tied to your personality?
Some people put a BGM or turn the radio on while they work. Others require quietude to concentrate on the job. Which type are you and why?
Which would you like to improve more, your attitude toward work or your social life?

Some believe one should be sentenced to death if he/she kills someone else intentionally. Others believe people have no right to kill a human being no matter what. Where do you stand on this issue and for what reasons?
Do you agree or disagree with the following statement? The most important influences that young adults have are from their peers. Use specific reasons and details to explain your view.

Some people prefer to keep up with the current affairs on a daily basis by watching news on TV and reading newspapers. Others are more concerned about their daily chores and do not mind being out of touch for a short while. Which type are you and why? Use specific reasons and details to explain your attitude.

In your opinion, is it acceptable or not acceptable for college administrators to receive higher salaries than the famous professors with excellent research and teaching skills? Why? Use specific reasons and details to justify your view.
Which academic subject do you think is more useful for the general public, Arithmetic or Expository Writing? Why? Use specific reasons and details to justify your choice.
Which would you like to have more money for, traveling as you like or buying things you like? Why do you prefer that? Use specific reasons and details to justify your choice.
Generally speaking, do you tend to prefer shared responsibilities or the ones assumed individually? Use specific reasons and details to justify your preference.
Do you pay more attention to the manufacturer’s name or to the price tag when you shop? What is the reason for that?
Which would you more like to have, a few very close friends or many acquaintances? Why is it your preference?

Some people prefer leaders who are honest. Others prefer leaders with good people management skills even if they may seem scheming at times. Which type are you? Use specific reasons and details to justify your choice.
Some people enjoy growing plants indoors, while others feel plants should be kept outdoors. What is your opinion? Use specific reasons and details to justify your position.
Some people like cartoons better than text-based articles in the newspaper. Are you or are you not one of those people? Why? Explain your reasons with specific details.
For some people enjoying the food they like is more important than staying fit. For others health has absolute priority over indulgence. Which type are you?

Some believe one should remember past failures so that he/she would not repeat them. Others believe it is best to forget them to start from scratch. Which is closer to your belief? How? Use specific reasons and details to justify your position.

Some have dinner together or play golf together to discuss business deals. Other people meet at the office and discuss them in their daily work environment. Which do you think works better? Include specific details and examples to support your view.

Suppose you are already running a very successful business and have a choice between selling it for a huge profit and expanding it to try to make it even more profitable. Which course of action are you more likely to take and for what reason(s)? Your speech should include specific details.

Some believe sufficient unemployment insurance is a very important safety net for workers. Others believe such insurance money makes jobless people less eager to look for a job. Which view do you support? Explain your opinion with specific details and examples.
You can either live on one of the upper floors of a high-rise condominium or pick a unit on a lower floor. Which would you choose and why?
Suppose you had sometime to spare on weekends. Are you more likely to spend that time for your hobby or for community service? Explain your reasons for that choice with specific details.
Your school has an extra classroom and would like to use it either as a study room or a computer laboratory. Which would you suggest and why? Be sure to include specific reasons in your speech.
Work or family, which is or would be more important for you? This is supposing you had a family. Give specific reasons for your priority.

When things are already working well, many people do not change anything saying, “Don’t try to fix what is not broken.” On the other hand, there are those risk takers who would still try new things hoping for further improvements. Which course of action are you more likely to take and for what reason(s)?

Some feel medical malpractices are mostly the doctors’ fault and they should be held responsible. Others feel patients should understand the risks involved in any treatment and accept the fact that people do make mistakes from time to time. In other words, they feel some patients are too unforgiving. Which opinion is closer to yours and why?
Which do you think is a better opportunity, an opportunity to see many other parts of your country or an opportunity to visit one foreign city? Explain your reasons with specific details.
Do you agree or disagree with the opinion that women are better care takers of their children than men? Support your view with specific reasons.
Which would make you more uncomfortable, people laughing at you or people crying in front of you? Why is it the case? Your speech should include specific reasons for your reaction.

If you buy the textbook, it of course costs you money, but you can keep it even after the class is over. If you borrow a copy from the library, you have to return it when it is due. Which would you choose to do about textbooks? What are your reasons for that decision?

Some people are comfortable with doing a passable job. But, others just have to do the best job possible on any assignment. Which type are you more like and why? Explain your attitude with specific reasons and details.
There are those who find visiting a resort most relaxing. There are also those who feel staying home and doing nothing is most relaxing. Which is your choice and why?
Some couples prefer sitting side by side at a restaurant, while others like it better to sit facing each other. Which do you prefer and why? Support your choice with specific reasons.
Which would you less like to do tonight, drinking beer or eating ice cream? Include specific reasons and details in your answer.
Some students do better under a strict teacher. Other students thrive when the teacher is lenient. Which type are/were you? Why are/were you that way? Give specific details in your explanation.
Some get nervous when they are in a large crowd. Others become restless when they are alone. Which is more likely to happen to you? Why? Explain with clearly stated reasons and some details.
Are you more likely to appreciate someone who is reserved or someone who is aggressive? Use specific reasons to support your attitude.
What would you like more money for, to help the needy or to support a local museum? Use specific reasons and details to justify your choice.
When you prepare for an examination, do you make a study schedule before you start or form a study plan as you go? Which do you prefer?

Some have enough discipline to control their spending even when they see bargain-priced items. Others tend to buy even unnecessary things when they are offered at a discount. Which is more likely to happen to you? Use specific reasons and details in your explanation.

Some people pick their majors in order to land a good job. Others choose the fields that interest them most. Which is your criterion? Why? Be sure to include specific details and examples in your answer.
Some prefer living close to work even if it means they have no yard to speak of. Other people don’t mind commuting from far away if they can enjoy a specious yard. Which do you prefer?
Generally speaking, which is more likely to appeal to you, outdoor activities or indoor activities? Give specific reasons for your preference.
If you spend your spare time with the coworkers, you cannot truly relax. Do you agree or disagree with this statement? Be sure to include specific details in your speech.
Suppose people are chatting during a lecture and it distracts you. Would you tell them to be quiet or bring it to the instructor’s attention? Why is it your preferred way to resolve it?

Some say male secretaries are as competent as female secretaries. Others feel female secretaries are better on the average. What is your opinion? Explain why you feel that way with specific reasons and details.

Some say you should not marry someone just because you are fond of that person. However, people often say love grows if you marry someone who is good to you. In other words, they support marrying someone you like even if there may not be love in the beginning. What is your opinion? Explain your views and thoughts with specific and detailed reasons.

You have a question about the course you are trying to enroll in. Would you like to go and ask the instructor or talk to a friend of yours who has already taken it? What is the reason for that course of action?
Which do you think is a bigger event in one’s life, birth or death? Include specific reasons and details in your explanation.
You have heard someone was saying nasty things about you. Would you confront the person or just ignore it? Which are you more likely to do? Explain your likely behavior with detailed reasons.
Some study best when they feel like studying. Others study best when they have to study for an upcoming examination. Which way are you like on this account?

Some money was stolen and you know who did it. If it were a small amount and if you knew the person well, would you turn the person in or talk to the person yourself? Use specific reasons to support your choice.

Some people go out and celebrate when they finish a big examination. Other people go home and rest. Which do you do most often? Why is that what you do? Use specific reasons and details to support your choice.
When you have an appointment, are you more likely to arrive well ahead of time or with little time to spare? What makes you do so?
If you keep a private diary, no one else will see it. On the other hand, if you start a blog, many people may read what you wrote and even comment on it. Which do you prefer and for what reason(s)?

Some believe one’s appearance tells a lot about his/her personality. Others think appearance could be very deceiving. Which view is yours and why? Support your view with specific examples and details.

Your friend has bought a new coat. You know it is very expensive. But, it does not suit her. If you are asked for an opinion, would you honestly tell her what you think or try to hide your true opinion? Be specific and detailed in your explanation.
Would you like to spend most of your life holding the same job, or would you prefer to spend some time on a different job/different jobs?
Life has ups and downs. Which do you remember better, good experiences or bad experiences? Include specific examples and reasons in your speech.
Some people openly admit it when he/she does not know something. But, others try to hide it. Which are you more likely to do? Use specific reasons and details in your explanation.

Some classes are solely lecture based. The instructor covers the material in more or less a linear and efficient manner. Other classes provide much opportunity for class discussions where the learning tends to be more nonlinear and time consuming. In the end, which format do you think contributes more to the students’ deeper understanding of the material? Explain your reasons with sufficient detail.

Some teachers are interested in the students’ personal affairs. They believe it helps them to be good teachers. Other teachers are more businesslike. They teach well and act professionally in the class, but they have no interest in what the students do in their private time once the class is over. They believe that is the way it should be. Which do you think is better? Use specific reasons and details in your explanation.

You can either pick a small seminar-type class led by one professor or a large class consisting of a series of lectures given by several professors. Which would you prefer? Give specific reasons in sufficient detail.

Some TV commercials focus on the merits of the product they are trying to sell, while others emphasize the relative superiority of their products over the competition. Which strategy would you adopt if you were to produce a TV commercial and why?

When you see a very expensive car, do you think the owner is trying to show off or he/she just loves cars very much? Why do you react in that way? Include specific reasons and details in your explanation.

Some students are very independent and they try to organize their own learning. Others rely on the teacher to keep them on the right track. Which type are you and why? Explain in detail with specific reasons and examples.
Which do you respect more, intelligent people or reliable people? Give specific reasons to support you answer.
Some bosses set very high standards to inspire the workers. Other bosses use easy goals to encourage the workers. Which strategy makes more sense? Your reasons have to be both specific and detailed.

Some workers are friendly and helpful to his or her coworkers. But, they are not necessarily very diligent. Others are very competent and diligent but are neither friendly nor helpful. Which type of workers do you think make a bigger contribution to the company?
Some students can concentrate better when they read aloud, while other students read silently to concentrate on the meaning. Which mode do you prefer?

Some presenters use slides, pictures, music, and videos to appeal to the audience. Others just stand and talk and look around at the audience to keep them focused on the presentation. Which is your style or which style would you like to adopt? Give specific reasons in your explanation.

There are those who get motivation from praises. There are also others whose source of motivation is self-satisfaction. Which do you think works better generally speaking? Include specific details in your speech.

Some like attending summer school as the courses follow an intensive format, covering as much as they would during regular semesters in a much shorter time. Others dislike the highly concentrated format. Do you or do you not like taking classes in a summer session? Explain why you are that way with specific details and examples.
When you share a ride with friends, would you like to sit in the front or in the back when you are not driving? Justify or explain your choice with specific reasons.

Some people believe parents should get involved in school if possible even for college students. Others believe it interferes with fostering independent spirits. Where do you stand on this issue? Use specific reasons and examples to support your view.
Would you prefer to manage a soccer team or be a star player of the team? What makes you go for that choice?
