Do you or do you not want to travel to the outer space if you could go for free? Include specific reasons for your preference in the speech.
Some billionaires lead very luxurious lives, but others live like ordinary people. Which style appeals to you more and why? Your speech should include specific details.

Your very cheap watch breaks down right after you have bought it. Are you more likely to complain to the company or just purchase another one in that kind of a situation. Explain with specific reasons for your action.
Some feel love affairs for high school students get in the way of their studies. Others feel they gain much from such experiences. Which opinion do you support for what specific reasons?

Some say detergents cause environmental destruction and one should refrain from using them. On the other hand, it is generally a good practice to wash your dishes thoroughly with detergent to avoid problems such as bacterial infection. Which side do you support and why? Give specific reasons for your choice.

There are advocates of the idea to make all the textbooks electronic for grade school children in order to reduce the load on the environment and make it easier for the children to commute to school with less to carry. Do you agree or disagree with this idea and why?
“Two lives are more important than the life of just one person.” If “life” here is used as in life or death, do you agree or disagree with this statement and why?
Suppose someone you know has been killed. Would a death penalty for the criminal bring a closure to you or would it not? Why do you think you would feel that way?

Suppose your child in grade school is addicted to online games and spends too much time and money on them, even skipping school from time to time. Would you forcefully make the child go to school and give up online games or keep talking to that child patiently? Why?
When you are given a grade that you do not think you deserve, are you happy or uncomfortable? Why do you feel that way?
“History repeats itself.” Do you agree or disagree with this idea and why?

Some professors believe in what they call an “upward momentum”, and they give better grades to the students whose standings improve on the final examination over the midterms. Do you agree or disagree with this practice? Include specific details.
You are at home and relaxing when a large earthquake strikes. Are you more likely to go beneath a sturdy desk or try to run out of the house? Why is it your likely action?

Do you agree or disagree with standardizing English, thereby only the British and American English are officially acceptable. This is with the understanding that nonnative speakers can only try their best efforts.
Do you or do you not feel comfortable borrowing money from a friend of yours? Why?
Some say a strong army is necessary to be taken seriously in the international community. Do you agree or disagree with this statement? Justify your opinion with specific reasons.
“College students should read a newspaper every day.” Do you agree or disagree with this statement? Give specific reasons for holding that opinion.
If you had a choice between noodles and fried rice, which would you prefer and why?
Some prefer boiled broccoli, while others like it uncooked. Which do you like better and why?
You have a choice between living in a noisy neighborhood in the middle of the city close to work and in a quiet suburban setting far from work? Which would you prefer and why?
Do you feel breaking a rule once is not much or fear that breaking it once may lead to doing so repeatedly? Why?
Would you or would you not mind if your sweetheart is also friendly with other men/women, assuming it is not a romantic relationship? Why?
Some believe old and experienced people make better political leaders, while others feel young blood is necessary so that the current and changing situation is reflected upon politics.

You could make your lifetime dream come true if you sell someone else’s happiness to the devil. Provided you do not know beforehand who that person will be, would you or would you not deal with the devil? Why?

Some stains, such as a coffee stain, do not disappear even after washing with a detergent. Would you wear casual clothes with such stains to walk a dog or would you not? Explain why you behave that way?

Compare two qualitatively different societies. In one society, your efforts usually count and winners are well rewarded, but losers may have to lead miserable lives. In the other, most people can live comfortably whether they are making much positive contributions or not, and not many are left behind. Which society do you like better and why?

Use of fossil fuels and radioactive materials for power generation is certainly more cost-effective compared with more environment-friendly means such as wind-aided and solar power generation. Are you willing to be inconvenienced now to accommodate future generations or would you rather not as you live only once?

Suppose you were a composer whose life is not going well at the moment. Would you compose a sad song to reflect your current state of mind or compose a happy song to express your hope for a better future? Why?

When you are trying to use your creativity to come up with an original idea, are you more likely to sit down, concentrate, and think hard, or do something else such as walking around to stimulate your brain? Why?
Suppose you could get a body that does not require any sleep in exchange for five years of your life, would go for that option or would you not?

You had just found a person standing near the edge of the roof of your office building. Would you try to talk to the person for fear that he/she might be trying to kill himself/herself, or would you not? What are your reasons for the action?
If you were a TV director, would you be inclined more to create a program which educates the public or one that entertains the public. Why?
A famous novelist said, “Those who do not even try to improve themselves are stupid.” Do you agree or disagree with this statement? Support your view with specific reasons.

Some believe art museums should exhibit works of art but should not sell them or related products for profit due to their public nature. Others believe selling works of art and other products should help the general public appreciate art more. Where do you stand regarding this issue? Why?
Some figure skaters are known for their artistic performance. Others’ strength is mainly their skating technique such as jumping. Which type do you appreciate more and why?
If you were to choose between British English and American English, what would be your choice and why?

You have a choice between conducting business aggressively like a mighty warrior and cleverly like a calm strategist. Which do you like better? Support your preference with specific reasons and details.

Some people are comfortable taking the responsibility for their conduct themselves. Some like it better when others, such as their bosses, assume the responsibility for their actions. Which type are you and why?
You have a choice between an easy low-paying job and a demanding job that pays well. Which are you more likely to choose and why?

Your work is not finished. But, it is already past the usual bedtime for you. Would you try to stay up late and finish the job because you will probably sleep better that way, or would you get up early next morning and finish the rest of the job? Be as specific as possible in your explanation.
You have a choice between having one big achievement in your life and achieving many but smaller things. Which would you prefer and why? Include specific reasons in your explanation.
Some like cutting-edge technology. Others prefer time-tested technology. Which would you choose and why? Specific details and/or examples will help.

Some advocates making it mandatory for former criminals to wear an anklet with a GPS device, so that the authority can keep track of them and prevent them from committing another crime. Do you agree or disagree with this opinion and for what reason(s)? Your explanation should contain specific details.
Which is more important to you, air conditioning in summer or heating in winter? Be sure to include the specific reasons for your preference.

You are at a furniture store to buy one specific model of a desk. If they were sold out of that particular item but had an equally attractive substitute, are you more likely to purchase that model or still insist on the initial choice even if it might mean a long wait or going to a different store? Don’t fail to include the reasons to support your decision.
When you wear a pair of pants and a T-shirt, which would you put on first, the pants or the T-shirt? Explain why you wear them in that order.
On a hot summer day, which would you prefer, ice cream or cold beverage?

Some say technical creativity like the one exhibited by engineers is more important than operational creativity that often leads to a good business model. Others feel the emphasis should be on the operational creativity. Which is more important in your opinion? Support your judgment by specific and detailed reasons.

There is an assertion that students have one common intelligence, the core intelligence, that contributes to performing well both in sciences and humanities. Yet, there is also an assertion that different parts of the brain are employed in sciences and humanities. Which do you think is closer to the truth? Include specific reasons in your argument.

Suppose you have a superb skill to make it a better world. Would you use it to make direct contributions to the betterment of human society or try to teach the skill to others and make more indirect contributions? Your speech should be to the point with specific details.

Who do you think are more valuable to human society, those who are talented and can make individual contributions or those who are good at leading a team to a common goal? Explain your reason(s) with specific details and examples.
When you do not feel well, are you more likely to go to see a doctor right away or wait and see how your body responds? Please explain why you take that course of action with specific details.
Some people try to avoid public restrooms at all costs. Others are not as sensitive. Which type are you and why? Include specific reasons in your speech.
When you notice that some food item is past the expiration date by a few days, would you consume it or would you not? Explain what you would do in specific terms.
Some like fruits that are completely ripe. Others prefer eating them a little before they ripen completely. Which do you prefer? Explain your preference with specific reasons.

Some think getting together after work occasionally is an integral part of creating a good chemistry among the workers. Others feel that time is better spent with the family or for other personal activities. What is your opinion? Please be specific.

Some refuses to drink alcoholic beverages outright on any occasion. Others call themselves casual and social drinkers and feel that it is important to drink when such is deemed necessary for social reasons. Which attitude would you support? Justify your position with specific reasons and details.

Landmines are a huge threat to the wellbeing of the local people including children. Which do you think is more effective, to try to help remove those mines or engage in a campaign to dissuade people from using mines. Be as specific as possible in your explanation.

Some people say that being nice to others is evidence of unselfishness. Others claim that such deeds are a process of fulfilling one’s own values; that is, it is simply one kind of selfish behavior. Where do you stand on this issue? Please include specific details in your speech.

Some people maintain that college students have the right to choose not to attend some classes as long as they can study by themselves. Other people think that college students should take every class seriously so that they can train their will to resist temptations and prepare for their lives in society after graduation. What is your opinion? Use specific reasons and examples to support your point of view.
Do you or do you not think it is justifiable to use a small nuclear weapon when a country is losing a war against an invading country? Support your views with specific reasons.

If a country is controlled by a dictator and the general public are suffering from poverty, is that alone a good enough reason to assassinate the dictator? How do you feel about the dictator’s human rights and the people’s rights to lead a happy life? Specific details and examples will help.

Of all your material possessions, what is the most important? Tell what it is, describe what it is like, and explain why it is so important. Please include specific details in your explanation.
